# NodeFlow — Universal Visual Diagram & Architecture Studio

> Open source, browser-based, local-first visual diagramming and system architecture studio.
> https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/

## Overview
NodeFlow is an diagramming workbench that runs in the browser. It unifies 30+ modeling languages, design formats, and specifications into a live reactive canvas with no account and no NodeFlow backend.

## Key Capabilities
- **Local-First Privacy**: All diagram compilation, WebAssembly execution, and IndexedDB project persistence occur locally. Nothing is sent to a cloud service unless you choose Gemini or an OpenAI-compatible AI provider, which receives the prompt you submit.
- **Cross-Disciplinary Workflows**:
  - *Product Managers (PM)*: User story mapping, quarterly OKRs, and customer journey maps.
  - *QA & Testing*: Defect triage lifecycles, automated CI/CD smoke test gates, and test coverage matrices.
  - *Developers & Cloud Architects*: Microservice architectures, ER schemas, git trunk flows, and GIS vector tile pipelines.
  - *Operations & Governance*: Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and approval chains.
  - *Students & Researchers*: Thesis structures, scientific method protocols, and semester course plans.
- **30+ Supported Formats**:
  - Native Mermaid & Graphviz WebAssembly (C compiler in Wasm)
  - PlantUML, Draw.io XML, D2, BPMN 2.0, C4 / Structurizr DSL, Terraform HCL
  - SQL DDL, DBML, Prisma, Protobuf, JSON Schema, GraphQL SDL, OpenAPI 3, AsyncAPI
  - Adobe Illustrator, Figma / FigJam, Lucidchart, OmniGraffle, Miro, StarUML, Visio VDX, Gliffy, Excalidraw, XMind ZEN
  - GeoJSON, Shapefile attributes, and Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) protobuf specs
- **Interactive Multi-Tab Canvas**:
  - VSCode-style multi-tab management with context menus (Close, Close Others, Close to the Right, Close All, Duplicate)
  - Auto-centering and content framing without dead whitespace
  - Dynamic theme-adaptive canvas (Light, Dark, Forest, Neutral) with custom grid rendering
  - Presentation mode with laser pointer
